messages:
sasha: Spike idea  can we add a 'variant uncertainty band' to the per-model cost card? Product wants to see whether an apparent cost delta is statistically meaningful before changing routing.

kevin: Yes. If we attach sample_rate and use bootstrap-ish CI from weighted samples we can surface confidence. But bootstrap on inverse-prob weighted samples needs careful variance estimation.

meera: Suggestion: store second-moment accumulators at ingest: sum_w, sum_wx, sum_wx2 where w=1/sample_rate and x=tokens_out or cache_saved_tokens. That allows closed-form VAR estimators for aggregated sums.

sasha: Nice. That avoids heavy re-sampling. Also include a 'sample_n' count so UI can decide when to hide bands (< 30 samples).

route-bot: deploy: schema-v3-second-moments branch applied to staging at 1720000150.

data-team: We'll run a calibration job to compare variance estimates vs bootstrap on historical data. Also will produce a recommended threshold for "significant" (p < 0.05).

sasha: UX: show band + a small p-value badge. Default: hide bands when sample_n < 50. Provide a tooltip: "uncertainty estimated from sampled telemetry".

kevin: Perf note: maintaining second-moment counters increases aggregator storage but it's just a few numeric columns per key. Fine.

meera: One more: quantization of variant names for PII reasons in some private deployments. We should offer model_name_hash or token_class column and let tenant opt-out of variant names in UI.

data-team: We'll add a daily reconciliation check (weighted vs ground truth) and post results to #eng-platform for visibility.

sasha: Tasks: meera to update schema proto + aggregator API; kevin to add variance fields to aggregator; data-team to run calibration + validation; i'll update console mocks with confidence band UI.
